correctness.rationale: An exact group calculation gives \([g,h]=(1,(a-1)y-(b-1)x)\). For fixed units the linear map has image \(\pi^sR\) and precisely \(q^{n+s}\) preimages of every element therein. Counting the nested unit sets yields the stated integer coefficients, including \(M_0=q^{2n-1}(q-2)\). The q=2 support boundary, monotonicity, and each valuation multiplicity follow algebraically. Direct finite enumeration over twelve modular/dual-number examples reproduced the full target fibers; finite testing is not used to prove all parameters.

value.rationale: The complete nonidentity commutator distribution is a natural, group-invariant word-map statistic for the infinite family AGL_1(R). The theorem identifies every fiber with exact multiplicity, an abrupt difference in attainable commutators at residue size two, strict valuation stratification, and uniformity across different commutative chain rings. It gives more information than the identity fiber, not an arbitrary finite slice or a renaming of a known commuting-probability formula.
